_comment: 27B-class geometry (qwen3_5_27b preset) on the 3 nm-class die of qwen35_9b_3nm_hbm: four layer ASICs of sixteen layers (four R,R,R,G groups each, so global_every is 4) and one head ASIC holding the whole LM head (5.71B coefficients, about 227 mm2 of fabric). Fabric at 2 GHz: 4 passes x 2560 cycles = 5.1 us per layer, 1.3 us per head die. Otherwise as the 9B 3 nm configuration. Each recurrent layer reads and writes its 512 KB Gated DeltaNet state through the local memory every token, and all stages of a die share one memory interface.
